rawContent:
Tweet by @elves_skill (Elves - They work while you sleep)
Author bio: Open-source Agent Skill for autonomous overnight development

Works with Claude Code, Codex, and any Agent Skill

Original author and maintainer: @johnennis
Text: Elves update (through v2.23.1)

Grok Build is a first-class host now, same as Claude Code and Codex.

If you live in Grok, you can install Elves with a one-liner, run the doctor, and follow the same guide. You do not have to bounce into Claude or Codex just to orchestrate a long run.

Since we last posted at v2.21:

Calling Fugu is less painful. You can dry-run with --preflight, stretch a plain call with --max-wait instead of jumping to --deep, and still get partial salvage if the wall kills the run.  

Overnight runs are a bit calmer. Mid-run we prove what actually changed and save polish for the end. 

Full-run resume will refuse to rebuild a session that already finished or whose event log cannot be read.

Review gets a clearer “look here first” signal from worker confidence. It is still triage only. It never skips gates or decides merge.

Optional extras if you need them: pin a live-catalog worker model, or Parallelves when the work really splits.

This was a big update, so let us know what you think!
